justification: The ghost inverts the core mechanism: original describes a ratio-based estimator on successive deltas converging to eigenvalue (requires ≥3 verdicts, noisy due to stochasticity); ghost claims direct lost-set magnitude measurement (one verdict, exact). These are contradictory architectures, not a partial view. The ghost's claims (single verdict, exactness, no ratios) systematically contradict the original's claims (multi-verdict, noise, delta ratios). The loss is not a finer detail to recurse on—it is the entire methodological claim. The added material is structurally coherent but orthogonal to and incompatible with the original.
